Transparent.summary: Gets a colour with all components (red, green, blue, and alpha) set to zero.

White.summary: Gets a colour with all components (red, green, blue, and alpha) set to their maximum intensity.

R.summary: The red component of the colour.

G.summary: The green component of the colour.

B.summary: The blue component of the colour.

A.summary: The alpha (opacity) component of the colour.

Indexer.summary: Gets or sets the colour component at the specified index.
Indexer.param: The zero-based index of the component to get or set (0 for R, 1 for G, 2 for B, and 3 for A).
Indexer.value: The value of the component at .
Indexer.exception: is less than 0 or greater than 3.

CtorRgba.summary: Initializes a new instance of the colour using the specified red, green, blue, and alpha values.
CtorRgba.param: The alpha component value. Defaults to full opacity.

CtorGrayscale.summary: Initializes a new grayscale instance of the colour with equal red, green, and blue values and the specified alpha value.
CtorGrayscale.param: The intensity value to assign to the red, green, and blue components.
The alpha component value. Defaults to full opacity.
